facts.fact: Vetogate reports that the Ministries of Justice and of Communications launched on 7 November 2026 a remote power of attorney service that verifies identity through the digital identity app and completes it with an approved electronic signature.

Vetogate reports that citizens prove identity online in the digital identity app by a face scan matched to the biometric record in state databases, to obtain a remote power of attorney through the Digital Egypt platform from 7 November 2026.
